Long, flowing platinum white hair with straight-cut bangs across the forehead. Calm, deep sapphire blue eyes with a gentle expression. Apparent age is early twenties with a mature, serene face. Slender, graceful build. A high-waisted, sleeveless white gown with gold embroidery and a flowing pale blue cloak. A small, golden tiara rests upon the brow.
BODY COLOR: pale ivory
